visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and fair skin, wearing a black T-shirt with the word 'SORRY!' in white, faces the camera in a brightly lit indoor living room. He uses animated facial expressions and hand gestures to speak directly to the viewer. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the man leaning over a blue plastic basin filled with water. He has pink and yellow clips in his hair. He scoops water with his hands and splashes it onto his face repeatedly to dampen his skin. (3) He displays a small amount of white, thick cleanser on his palm. The texture appears dry and sticky. He shows a frustrated expression, looking at the camera with wide eyes and hands raised to signify difficulty in using the product. (4) He holds up a white cylindrical bottle labeled 'SHIMBI' towards the camera. He shakes the bottle vigorously with one hand to demonstrate its contents, standing in the same indoor setting with a soft-lit background. (5) He applies white, dense foam from the SHIMBI bottle to specific areas of his face: his forehead, nose, chin, and finally his cheeks. He uses his fingertips to massage the foam in circular motions as he explains the procedure. (6) He splashes water from the blue basin onto his face again to rinse off the foam. After rinsing, he leans toward the camera, pointing to his skin which now appears bright, smooth, and highly reflective under the light. (7) He holds up a rough yellow towel and makes a face of disapproval, then swaps it for a soft, white disposable facial tissue, which he gently pats against his skin to dry his face. (8) Close-up on his cheek as he touches it with one finger, demonstrating the skin's elasticity. Animated sparkle effects appear around his face to emphasize the glow. (9) He introduces a silver and white double-chambered bottle. He pumps two different textures of serum onto the back of his hand—one yellow and one clear—and mixes them with his finger before applying to his face. (10) He holds a small white bottle with a glass pipette. He uses the dropper to apply a clear liquid serum directly onto his forehead and T-zone, massaging it in with gentle upward strokes. (11) He presents a full range of SHIMBI skincare products arranged on a wooden table. He smiles broadly at the camera, gesturing towards the products and his clear skin to conclude the demonstration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, high-energy male narrator speaking in Traditional Chinese over a driving electronic pop beat. The music features a crisp synthesized bassline and rhythmic drum machine patterns. The narrator's tone is friendly and highly persuasive, set against a silent studio background floor. (2) As the washing demonstration starts, loud, clear splashing water sound effects are layered over the narration. A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the cut to the cleanser demonstration. The narrator's pitch rises during humorous commentary about poor product textures. (3) A series of 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects punctuate the application of facial foam. The background music maintains a constant tempo, but the vocal energy increases as the narrator describes the benefits of the SHIMBI mousse. A high-pitched 'ding' SFX highlights the appearance of clear skin. (4) Transitioning to the serum section, the BGM remains steady while the narrator's delivery becomes more instructional and narrative-focused. Technical 'click' SFX accompany the pumping of the double-tube serum bottle, followed by smooth 'sparkle' SFX when the final glowing skin is revealed. (5) The final phase features a climax in vocal arousal and loudness as the narrator delivers a call to action. The electronic BGM reaches its fullest arrangement before a quick fade-out. Every technical SFX and music transition is perfectly synchronized with the fast-paced visual editing.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Common Mistakes -> Product Demonstration -> Advanced Care -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a strategic marketing endorsement for the SHIMBI skincare line. It utilizes a 'step-by-step secret tutorial' format to build credibility, showing the creator's transformation from basic face washing to a complete skincare regimen. The high-energy editing and visual 'glow' effects are designed to appeal to skincare enthusiasts and drive sales.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the brand SHIMBI, demonstrates multiple products from the line, shows their packaging in close-ups, and informs viewers where the products can be purchased.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses social-media native editing style with rapid cuts and varied text overlays to maintain high viewer engagement throughout the product pitch.
